text: hey everybody very excited to let y'all know that I recently signed a contract with Saint Martin's publishing Group which is affiliated with MacMillan to
write a trade volume that confronts misconceptions about the Bible and what it actually says
or doesn't say about various controversial topics so as a trade volume this is not an academic book this
will be written for a general audience and I'm anticipating it'll have about 15 chapters or so and will basically cover the greatest hits of what I talk about
on social media so there will be chapters on inerrancy and univocality and homosexuality in the Bible and is
Jesus God and is the devil in the Bible is hell in the Bible all that uplifting content that you love hearing me drone
on about in a very monotone voice so it is slated for release sometime in early 2025. I've got a handful of months to
complete writing it and I'm sure you can anticipate getting updates from me as it moves through the different phases of
composition and production and you can keep an eye out for the final product in early 2025.
